title: Private V2 sells (full and partial) use the non-fee-on-transfer swapExactTokensForETH and V3 sells cannot handle transfer-taxed tokens, so taxed tokens never sell privately and never take partial profit

evidence.note: public fallback uses swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens; the comment at :501-503 calls it the fee-on-transfer-safe variant
partial sells always use the non-FoT V2 builder and have no public fallback
V3 has no fee-on-transfer-safe fallback ("V3 has no fee-on-transfer-safe public router analog wired here")
strategies simulate before submit (also passthrough.ts:115-125, bloxroute.ts:131-141), so a reverting private sell is not sent and the ladder falls through quickly
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): Transfer-tax tokens cannot execute the standard V2 partial-sale path

sibling_sites_checked: All three sell builders: buildV2SellTx (:351-372, non-FoT), buildV3SellTx (:378-407, exactInputSingle), executePublicFallbackSell (:508-564, FoT-safe). The buy side allows taxed tokens up to the per-chain max sell tax (TH-BUY-19), so taxed positions are reachable. Simulate-before-submit in all three strategies means no gas is burned on the reverting private attempts.
severity_rationale: S2. The router choice is a code fact. That swapExactTokensForETH and exactInputSingle revert for a transfer-taxed token is standard Uniswap router behaviour, not provable from library source in this repo, so the entry stays candidate for a Phase 23 fork check. Effect if confirmed: V2 full exits of a taxed token always lose MEV protection (they go to the public fallback, sandwichable on ETH at 5% slippage), V2 partial take-profit sells never succeed and re-alert every cycle, and V3 taxed positions can never exit (the strand itself is recorded in AUD-EXIT-007).
recommendation: Use the supporting-fee-on-transfer variant on the private V2 leg and partial sells, and decide what a V3 taxed position does (refuse at buy time, or route its exit through a V2 pool). Card EXIT-05 (Phase 24, fork-proven).

steps: Tick: priceMultiple >= an unfilled tier multiple -> getUnfilledTiers (:1732); the partial is only detected here and dispatched at the end of the tick if no full exit fired (:1817-1826)
dispatchPartialSell (:1621-1655) calls executePartialSell without awaiting; a .catch guards the detached promise
executePartialSell (:1473): per-token sell lock (:1483-1486; a held lock skips this cycle), balanceOf and clamp to the held balance (:1490-1497)

Approval for exactly the partial amount under the nonce lock (:1509/:1512, public, no timeout on the wait) then the alert (:1521), then withNonceLock(sendTxWithRetry(txBuilder)) with amountOutMin 0 and, on V2, the non-FoT router call (:1531)

decodeReceipt (:1545-1547), insertTrade(action partial_sell, status sold) (:1550-1565), tiers added to state.completedTierIndices (:1568-1570) and persisted synchronously (:1575); the dispatcher persists again on success (:1646)
Failure (any throw, including a revert of the non-FoT call on a taxed token): warn only, the position stays open, the tier is re-detected on the next tick and retried (:1585-1588)
traces.outcome: State written on success: a trades row (action partial_sell, status sold) and exit_state.partial_tiers_completed updated; the high-water mark is not reset. On failure nothing is written and the same tier retries every 5 s with a new alert; for a transfer-taxed V2 token it never succeeds. A crash between the landed tx and the tier persist re-sells the tier after restart (AUD-EXIT-017).
